title: Interactive Program Induction with Language Model Priors
abstract: arXiv:2611.18485v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Program induction refers to the process in which a learner aims to recover a program from a few given input-output examples. This paradigm broadens programming access by letting users demonstrate the rule-based behavior they want to apply to unseen data, instead of having to implement it themselves. However, recovering a program from finite input-output examples is fundamentally ambiguous, as a finite set of input-output examples is theoretically consistent with infinitely many programs whose output diverges on unseen inputs. We view this problem from a Bayesian perspective, where, given a prior $p^0$ over programs, identifying the target program means concentrating posterior probability mass on it by observing additional input-output examples. In the interactive program induction setting, the learner chooses maximally informative inputs and queries an oracle, such as the user, for their outputs. We derive a greedy query-selection algo

translated_title: 基于语言模型先验的交互式程序归纳
translated_abstract: 程序归纳是指学习者从少量给定的输入-输出示例中恢复出程序的过程。这一范式通过让用户直接演示他们希望应用于未见数据上的基于规则的行为，而无需亲自实现该行为，从而降低了编程的门槛。然而，从有限的输入-输出示例中恢复程序在本质上存在歧义性，因为一个有限的输入-输出示例集在理论上与无穷多个程序相容，而这些程序在未见输入上的输出可能各不相同。我们从贝叶斯的视角来审视这一问题：在给定程序先验分布 p⁰ 的情况下，识别目标程序意味着通过观察更多的输入-输出示例，将后验概率质量逐步集中到该程序上。在交互式程序归纳的设定中，学习者会主动选择信息量最大的输入，并向预言机（例如用户）查询其对应输出。我们推导了一种贪心的查询选择算法……
tldr: 本文提出以语言模型作为程序先验的贝叶斯交互式程序归纳方法，通过贪心选择最具信息量的输入向预言机查询，逐步将后验概率集中于目标程序，以化解从有限示例归纳程序时固有的歧义性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian framework for interactive program induction that leverages language model priors and a greedy query-selection algorithm to actively query maximally informative input-output examples, thereby concentrating posterior probability on the target program and resolving the inherent ambiguity of inducing programs from finite examples.
